description: This Java class defines an immutable data object representing loan transaction enumerations for the Apache Fineract project. It contains fields for different transaction types, initialized based on an identifier, and includes logic to determine if a transaction is of a repayment type.

classes.name: LoanTransactionEnumData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing loan status enumerations, with fields for various transaction types and utility methods.

methods.name: LoanTransactionEnumData
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the transaction type based on given ID, code, and value.

methods.name: isRepaymentType
methods.description: Determines if the transaction type is a repayment-related transaction.
